title: Provision relating to income-tax, super-tax, etc
text:
42. Provision relating to income-tax, super-tax, etc.—For the purposes of the Income-tax Act,

1961 (43 of 1961), or any other enactment for the time being in force relating to income-tax,
super-tax or any other tax on income, profits or gains, a Food Corporation shall be deemed to be a
company within the meaning of the Income-tax Act, 1961, and shall be liable to tax accordingly on its
income, profits and gains.
